title: Build Connected Media & Entertainment Solutions with Oracle AI Database
short_description: Build Media campaign, content discovery, creator-network, distribution, demand-model, and AI workflows with one Oracle AI Database.
long_description: Follow the Seer Media team as they use the supplied Media handoff dataset in Oracle AI Database 26ai. Combine audience signals, content vectors, campaign-order JSON, and spatial data; inspect creator and studio relationships; train and score a demand-surge model; and query the five Media semantic views with Select AI and a SQL-only agent. Labs retain the physical object names and JSON fields defined by the platform loader.
